policy_notes: Reuse of prior measured completed fits as the CPU benchmark gate, explicitly subject to Claude review; this is not a newly measured LQ benchmark.

All five shard types: three original arms completed within the same CPU/memory/time caps. Exact same numerical source hashes, recipe and numeric_context are required; candidate fold counts must match historical T100-L.
Pool768 FP32 width, row/subject support and folds unchanged. Feature values can change solver iteration counts; historical timing is a proxy, not a guarantee.
No automatic cap increase, C-grid change, candidate exclusion or retry. Convergence warnings retain descriptive values but suspend the corresponding solver interpretation.
A source/numeric/shape mismatch blocks the reuse gate and needs a documented review, not relaxed validation.
